def: A convention, standardized as RFC 9309 in 2022, in which a site's /robots.txt file tells each named crawler which URL paths it may fetch; compliance is voluntary, not access control.
practice: The main opt-out signal publishers aim at AI crawlers; the Consent in Crisis study (2024) found such restrictions rising sharply from 2023 to 2024, shrinking the openly crawlable web for training.
